title: Vintage Grey Yoshiaki Tagami Comic Lot, Issues 1-3 Viz Select
descriptionText:
The product is a vintage comic lot by artist/writer Yoshihisa Tagami, featuring three issues of the series titled "Grey" published by Viz. The comics fall under the genre of manga and science fiction. This collectible set offers a unique glimpse into the world of graphic novels with a distinct character and storytelling style that fans of comics and manga will appreciate.

Vintage Grey comic series by Yoshihisa Tagami
Lot includes three issues
Issue No 1
Issue No 2
Issue No 3
Published by Viz Select Comics
Presented by Tokuma Shoten and Viz Comics
Classic early Viz manga release with iconic cover art
Great lot for collectors of Yoshihisa Tagami or vintage manga comics
You will receive the exact three comics shown in the photos
